narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate investors on the dangers of chasing popular thematic ETFs. By explaining that the time required for product design and regulatory approval often causes the market heat to dissipate before retail investors can buy in, it encourages a more critical approach to financial marketing.
